RUPEE CLIMBS PAST 93 TO 7-MONTH HIGH

On 20 November 2026 the Indian rupee rose to an intraday high of 92.91 per US dollar, breaking the 93 per dollar barrier for the first time since April. The move was driven by foreign portfolio inflows exceeding $12 billion in November.
The stronger rupee leaves Indian markets ahead of many Asian peers and reflects confidence amid a strong dollar and a hawkish Federal Reserve outlook. Traders will watch exporters’ dollar conversions and continued inflows for further currency gains.

For information only. Not investment advice.
